title: StudyLibrary Agent Protocol v2
purpose: Self-describing protocol for reading, auditing and updating structured study knowledge bases.
canonicalWorkflow: GET /api/v1/agent for live capabilities, supported operations, schemas and source policy. Never assume undocumented fields.
GET /api/v1/catalogs/{catalog}/agent for catalog ID, currentVersion, endpoints and audit.
GET /api/v1/catalogs/{catalog}/context for a compact index of existing concepts and IDs.
GET /api/v1/catalogs/{catalog}/audit; fetch /graph if prerequisites or cross-topic relations are relevant.
GET only the actual lesson and topic objects being modified. To patch a legacy section, read its zero-based sectionIndex from the current topic.
Analyze the supplied slides/PDFs; keep source-derived claims distinguishable from independent explanations and preserve citations.
Build a small studylibrary.update schemaVersion 2 JSON containing only the necessary operations, using the currentVersion as baseVersion.
Prefer patchTopic/updateLesson/updateSection for existing objects; addSection with a stable unique id. Never recreate existing topics just to append a paragraph.
Add media with verified provenance and source metadata; never infer rights or invent licensing.
Deliver the patch file for user preview/import. Public Knowledge API is read-only; authenticated owner writes use atomic version checking.
After the update, fetch the new version and audit for broken links, missing checkpoints, and orphaned references.

publicationModel.homeVisibility: is_public / visibility controls whether a catalog appears in the public Home.
publicationModel.apiVisibility: api.publicRead controls whether the catalog can be read from the public Knowledge API.
publicationModel.inheritance: Libraries, lessons and topics inherit API visibility unless they set api.publicRead. A private parent always hides descendants.

guidance: Do not turn slides into a verbatim transcription.
Build explanations progressively from intuition to formal detail.
Reuse an existing topic when the concept already exists instead of duplicating it.
Create explicit prerequisites only when they genuinely help the learning path.
Add cross-lesson, cross-library or cross-catalog connections when useful.
Keep checkpoint questions answerable from the topic content.
Preserve source identifiers and slide/page references.
Use relevant images/videos when they materially improve understanding; do not add decorative media.
For external media preserve sourceUrl, author/credit and license when known. Never invent license metadata.

sourcePolicy.ifSourceDoesNotSupportClaim: Mark it as an external explanation/inference or omit it.

operationContracts.addTopic: library, lesson, value: full topic with unique id; optional module, moduleTitle. Does NOT overwrite existing topic.
operationContracts.patchTopic: library, lesson, topic, changes: partial object. Only title/summary/why/estimatedMinutes/learningGoals/prerequisites/api. Does NOT replace sections or sources.
operationContracts.addSection: library, lesson, topic, value: section object with unique id and type. Optional index (0 based), beforeSectionId OR afterSectionId.
operationContracts.updateSection: library, lesson, topic, changes; select exactly one sectionId or zero-based sectionIndex. Patches existing fields; never alters type or id.
operationContracts.removeSection: library, lesson, topic; select sectionId OR sectionIndex. Final topic must still have a checkpoint.
operationContracts.addMedia: value: {id, type: image|video, url, alt?, sourceUrl?, credit?, license?}. Rejects existing different id payload.
operationContracts.updateMedia: media: id, changes: partial media metadata or URL (not ID or type).
operationContracts.removeMedia: media: id. Rejected when still referenced by any section/gallery.
operationContracts.addSource: library, lesson, value: {id, ...source metadata}; optional topic, pages and note attach a reference to that topic.
operationContracts.updateLesson: library, lesson, changes: partial title/description/estimatedMinutes/accent/api (no nested array replacement).
operationContracts.moveTopic: library, lesson, topic, toLesson; optional toLibrary, module, moduleTitle. Moves the topic object, retains its id.
operationContracts.upsertLesson: Legacy replacement of full lesson value: use only when full replacement intended.
operationContracts.upsertTopic: Legacy replacement of full topic value: use only when full replacement intended.
operationContracts.removeTopic: Legacy removal of topic and cleanup of direct same-lesson links.
operationContracts.addConnection: library, lesson, from, connection: {target,type,label?}. Duplicate links ignored.
operationContracts.removeConnection: library, lesson, from, target, optional type.

sectionSelection.newSections: Always assign a unique stable id when using addSection.
sectionSelection.existingSections: Use sectionId when available. For old sections without IDs, use sectionIndex (zero-based) read from the current full topic.
sectionSelection.ordering: index or beforeSectionId or afterSectionId; no selector means append.
sectionSelection.check: Re-read the topic before generating an index-based operation. baseVersion protects against concurrent changes.

updateStrategy.patchSemantics: Partial, shallow field assignments only. Arrays in changes are replaced as whole arrays, so use dedicated addSection/addSource/addConnection for additions. No silent merging of unrelated objects.
updateStrategy.concurrency: baseVersion REQUIRED, equals the currentVersion of the target cloud catalog. StudyLibrary validates the candidate and uses a server-side row lock and optimistic compare-and-swap when importing to avoid losing concurrent changes.
importFlow: validate package kind, schemaVersion 1|2 and baseVersion
apply operations to independent catalog copy
validate resulting catalog including checkpoint and source rules
commit via studylibrary_api_write with p_base_version and owner JWT
updateStrategy.privacy: Public GET only works for API-enabled, readable content. To write, user signs into StudyLibrary with Google; never request private access tokens in chat.
updateStrategy.sizeGuidance: Prefer a small patch JSON over exporting a whole catalog. A single new section should be one addSection operation, not an upsertTopic.

expectedUserPrompt: Use the StudyLibrary agent instructions from this URL, inspect the catalog agent/context/audit, then use the attached source material to prepare a version-aware update package.

media.automaticNormalization: Inline image/video URLs are deduplicated into catalog.media when the catalog is saved.
rules: Images should have meaningful alt text.
Use YouTube/Vimeo embeds only through the renderer's trusted provider handling.
Generic external resources are links, never arbitrary iframes.
Do not claim a media license unless the source supports it.

addExplanationToExistingTopic.message: Add practical example to spatial resolution

authenticatedWriting.requestBody: {p_catalog_id: UUID, p_base_version: currentVersion, p_message: string, p_catalog: merged full catalog snapshot, p_publish: null, p_api_public: null}
authenticatedWriting.authentication: Owner Supabase JWT via Authorization: Bearer <token>, managed in StudyLibrary UI. NEVER place tokens inside update JSON.
authenticatedWriting.note: The model supplies only the SMALL studylibrary.update JSON; the UI merges it into the existing catalog, and internally sends a full candidate snapshot to the server with atomic version checking. This is NOT a direct patch endpoint.
